occupations.cat: Refuse workers and other elementary workers

n.story:
Your role evolves from a 'fixer of problems' to a 'manager of smart environments.' The tedious administrative side of your job—writing up repair estimates, reading through dense technical manuals, and keeping maintenance logs—is almost entirely automated by AI. When you walk into a room, your AR glasses highlight hidden wiring plans and suggest the most energy-efficient ventilation upgrades, pulling data from thousands of technical datasheets instantly.

While your hands still do the heavy lifting of carpentry and electrical repair, your brain is amplified by predictive diagnostics. You no longer wait for a system to break; AI sensors alert you to mechanical wear before a failure occurs. This shift allows you to offer more strategic value to your clients, focusing on energy conservation and complex system optimization rather than just reactive repairs.
